description: Experiment values and measurement definitions. Benchmark commands calculate new measurements from their input records.
comparison_requirements: Fixed survey-disjoint splits and independent first-error annotations
Matched model revision, hardware, precision, batch/group sizes and token lengths
Recorded reward threshold, outcome tolerance, simulator geometry and software versions
Actual run manifests, durable checkpoints, allocation intervals and telemetry

metrics.context: Monte Carlo labels of SimPEG tool calls over public gravity surveys
metrics.measurement_path: geotrace/rollout_cli.py: collection manifest steps, geotrace/rollouts.py: label_trace
metrics.required_inputs: Actual survey source identifiers and collected textual tool traces

metrics.context: First-error detection supporting early trace pruning
metrics.required_inputs: Independent step annotations and validation-selected threshold on disjoint test surveys

metrics.context: GRPO group-relative advantages remove PPO critic
metrics.definition: 1 - sum(GRPO measured device peaks) / sum(PPO measured device peaks)
metrics.required_inputs: Matched workload object and measured per-device peak allocated byte arrays

metrics.context: 7B policy run fits on one node
Physics consistency verifiers and KL-anchored clipped process rewards
metrics.definition: Assigned reward at or above fixed threshold while independent final outcome fails, divided by all rollouts
1 - process mean held-out relative RMSE / outcome-only mean held-out relative RMSE
metrics.required_inputs: Matched test cases and separate receiver observations excluded from policy inputs

metrics.measurement_path: geotrace/ops/ledger.py:RunLedger.summary, aggregate actual experiment run manifest
metrics.required_inputs: Distinct interrupted job IDs, restored-attempt events and completion records

metrics.context: Durable experiment identity and recovery state
metrics.measurement_path: Actual launched-run manifest matched to durable ledger completion and checkpoint records
metrics.required_inputs: All launched run IDs and explicit completion/retention criteria

metrics.context: Useful committed work versus measured full reservation time
metrics.definition: Unique retained optimizer-step GPU hours / externally measured full allocation GPU hours
metrics.required_inputs: Valid step durations/device counts plus complete allocation intervals including idle/repeated work
